CArray

The CArray class template is a lightweight, memory-managed wrapper for a C-style array. It is used internally by the Array classes as a temporary buffer when assigning between overlapping arrays, and provides only the operations needed for that purpose:

  • CArray< int > v( n ) creates a CArray with n elements. Elements of built-in types are not initialized, for efficiency.
  • 0-based subscripting is provided by the [] operator, as in v[ i ].
  • Subscripting does bounds checking in debug builds.
  • The size function returns the number of elements.
  • CArrays are not copyable.
  • Array size and indexing types are std::size_t so very large arrays are supported on 64-bit platforms where std::size_t is a 64-bit unsigned integer.
